description: Compute a real natal (birth) chart from NASA JPL DE440S ephemerides with Skyfield: exact planetary longitudes, sign and degree, house placements (Placidus by default, Whole Sign on request), Ascendant and Midheaven, and the aspects between them. Requires an exact birth date, local birth time, latitude, longitude and IANA timezone, and it cannot compute houses or an Ascendant without a birth time. It does not geocode: call resolve_birthplace first to turn a place name into those exact numbers, and never supply coordinates or a timezone from memory — the zone sets the Ascendant and every house cusp, so a wrong one yields a confidently wrong chart. Returns the computed chart data and a plain link to the same free chart; it does not return product, price, offer-specific, purchase or checkout links.

city.description: Human-readable birth place label, for display only.

latitude.description: Birth latitude in decimal degrees, north positive.

locale.description: Language for the returned free-chart link. Defaults to en.

longitude.description: Birth longitude in decimal degrees, east positive.

time.description: Local birth time at the birth place, 24-hour HH:MM.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the birth place, e.g. "Europe/Madrid". Required — a wrong zone moves the Ascendant and every house cusp.

name: compute_natal_chart
title: Compute a natal chart
